_comment: Fallback runtime list for hosts where the docker CLI cannot reach the Hub.
Generate the real thing with: qpm runtimes --save-inventory /secure/inventory.json
token_env is preferred over inline token when the file may be read by others.
plugins_dir is the HOST path mounted at 'workspace' plus '/plugins'; it only
enables host-side backups/rollback and may be omitted.
username is display-only: the console shows it instead of the runtime id.
